description: Address code review findings: improve error handling in _get_child_current_unit_order, add comment explaining current_unit_order write-back design, add try/except for determine_next_problem, and add test for determine_next_problem failure
steps: Replace bare except Exception: pass in _get_child_current_unit_order with proper logging using Python's logging module. Log a warning on DynamoDB errors before falling back to 1.
Add a comment in the auto-select branch explaining that current_unit_order write-back happens in the grading flow via adaptive_learning/stats.py's _try_unlock_next_unit().

Wrap determine_next_problem call in try/except. On failure, log the error and fall back to defaults (subcategory='addition_no_carry', category='number_calculation', difficulty=1, question_count=8, weak_areas=[]).
Add a test for the case where determine_next_problem raises an exception, verifying it falls back to defaults gracefully.
acceptance_criteria: _get_child_current_unit_order uses logging.warning instead of bare except pass
Comment in code explains the write-back design for current_unit_order
determine_next_problem failure is caught with fallback to defaults
New test verifies determine_next_problem exception leads to default values
All tests pass with cd packages/agent && uv run pytest
verification: Run cd packages/agent && uv run pytest -v and confirm all tests pass
